nom: Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Magic Serum with Vitamin C

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one in her mid-50s, report the serum leaves their skin looking and feeling wonderful; one with dry skin also noticed a slight brightening and texture improvement but felt the price outweighed the benefit for her.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who describes her skin as combination/oily reports the serum does not feel sticky or greasy, has not caused breakouts despite usually struggling with heavy products, and has faded her fine lines and acne marks.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who also has acne-prone skin, report no irritation or breakouts; that same reviewer flags that the serum contains parfum and cautions it may not suit extremely sensitive skin, even though her own sensitive, acne-prone skin tolerated it well.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s and 50s report the serum leaves their skin soft, smooth and plump, including one in her mid-50s with dry skin and another who says it is working well on her 50-year-old skin.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the serum as strongly hydrating, leaving skin plumper, softer and more supple, often within days of starting use.
concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, added firmness or a more youthful look, especially crediting the Replexium and vitamin C combination; several others say they did not notice any dramatic difference in fine lines or overall results during their trial period.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say the serum did not cause redness, including one who felt a slight stinging sensation while applying it but saw no redness or breakouts afterward; one reviewer also credits the niacinamide in the formula with helping redness and texture.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the serum fades dark spots or acne marks and leaves their complexion brighter and more even after a few weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin, report the serum does not cause new blemishes, and a few say it helps existing or hormonal blemishes heal faster.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the serum absorbs without feeling greasy or oily, including one with combination/oily skin; one reviewer notes that her oilier skin of 15 years ago likely would not have suited this formula as well as her currently drier skin does.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight, silky texture that absorbs quickly
Doubles well as a makeup primer
Can pill or sit on top of skin instead of absorbing
Expensive; some feel it's not worth the price

extraits.texte: I really wanted to like this 😅 but I didn't. For this price it should not roll in to little balls on my face once it's dry, and it should soak in better than this..

This serum has a milky texture and feels very moisturizing on the skin. It gives an instant glow and makes your face feel smooth immediately. Because I have dry skin, I usually use about 4 to 5 drops for my entire face. I did notice a slight brightening effect and a slight improvement in the texture of my skin. One thing I really enjoyed was how compatible this was with my makeup. My foundation applied nicely on top of this and I didn't notice any pilling of my face makeup. Unfortunately, I probably would not repurchase this product in the future. Though I did enjoy this serum quite a bit, the price far outweighs the benefits of the product, in my opinion.

Now this is definitely worth the splurge! It's one of those serums that feels milky and luxurious. The ingredients are really what make this serum unique. It has a mix of Vitamin C, niacinamide, and polyglutamic acid, each targeting different skin concerns. Vitamin C and niacinamide together bring in brightness and even out skin tone. Polyglutamic acid, which is like an ultra hydrating hyaluronic acid, keeps moisture locked in for a dewy look. Also, the presence of glutathione acts as an antioxidant, neutralizing free radicals and helping to maintain a youthful glow. It also contains botanical extracts, like Replexium, a peptide blend that claims to help with firmness and reduce wrinkles, which helps skin look and feel a bit more plump over time. If you're sensitive to fragrance, just a heads up that this serum does contain parfum, so it might not be ideal for extremely sensitive skin. I have sensitive/acne prone skin and I haven't noticed any breakouts or irritation myself. The texture is lightweight and a little goes a long way. Not only does it layer well under makeup, but it actually works really well as a makeup primer too. Overall, I'd say it's worth its price tag and if you're willing to splurge on a serum, this should be this one. It combines multiple skincare benefits in one step, and it's truly unlike any other serum I've tried. I would confidently recommend it.

extraits.titre: A welcome part of my skin care routine
extraits.texte: Helps make my very dry 55+ skin feel and look wonderful.. I get compliments all the time about how good I look

I've been using this serum for about a week now and I'm really impressed with the results. It's incredibly moisturizing and has a brightening effect on my skin. The applicator makes it easy to apply, ensuring that I get just the right amount each time. The serum glides on smoothly and absorbs beautifully into my skin, leaving it feeling incredibly hydrated. What's great is that it doesn't leave my combination/oily skin feeling sticky or greasy. I usually struggle with products feeling too heavy and causing breakouts, but surprisingly, this serum hasn't done that. I've noticed that my fine lines are becoming less apparent and my skin has been getting brighter and more hydrated. Even my acne marks and fine lines have been fading since I started using this product. I highly recommend this serum and I will definitely be purchasing it again.
This Magic Serum with its crystal-infused replexium along with other ingredients is working so well on my 50 year old skin . The decent is divine and the packaging is stunning!

extraits.titre: Luxury serum, great for makeup prep
extraits.texte: I received the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Duo, which includes the "Crystal Elixir Serum" and the "Magic Cream" in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the duo together for about a week and really like the results! The Magic Serum Crystal Elixir absorbs quickly and makes my skin feel plump and smooth - it's light and not oily at all. I did not think the scent was overwhelming either. My face didn't look oily at all and felt great. No breakouts or irritation on my sensitive skin. The Magic Cream is rich, but not greasy and also absorbs quickly and nicely. My skin feels hydrated, but not greasy and ready for makeup! Again, no super string scent and no skin irritation. I am 48 years old and this makes my skin feel baby soft, smooth and plump!
